scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.gen:api: cd backend && uv run python -m app.export_openapi && cd ../tools/openapi-gen && bun run gen
scripts.check:api: bun run gen:api && git diff --exit-code -- frontend/api
scripts.build: bun run gen:api && bun run build.ts
scripts.start: bun run build && cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run pytest && cd .. && bunx tsc --noEmit
